svg.title: Before casting: a conservative fishing decision gate
svg.desc: A plain-language decision gate for deciding whether to fish in a Victorian bush emergency. First protect rescue, first aid, body temperature, shelter and drinking water. Then confirm the current licence or exemption, exact water and time, closures and notices, method, equipment, bait and species rules. Do not fish unless every likely catch can be positively identified and lawfully dealt with, and the bank, gear, weather, light and available time are safe. No or unknown at any gate means do not fish. The card supplies no traps, unattended lines, poison, electricity or other destructive method. Its subjective wording-confidence estimate is 90 percent and is not a probability of legal permission, safe catch, success or survival.
svg.text: Before casting: should you fish?
WARNING — EVERY GATE MUST PASS
Food is usually later than rescue, first aid, warmth and water.
A NO or UNKNOWN answer means DO NOT FISH.
Rules, closures, signs and health warnings can change.
Subjective wording-confidence estimate: 90%.
This rates the wording—not legal permission, catch safety,
success or survival.
1 IS SOMETHING MORE URGENT?
• Call for help, send your location or improve signalling
• Give first aid or manage an immediate threat
• Protect body temperature; improve shelter or clothing
• Secure enough safe drinking water
YES / UNKNOWN → DO NOT FISH. DO THAT TASK FIRST.
NO → CONTINUE TO GATE 2
NO — NEXT CHECK
2 CAN YOU CONFIRM THE CURRENT EXACT RULE?
Check the current VFA Guide, Fisheries Notices and signs:
• your licence or exact exemption;
• this water, date and time; every closure or restriction;
• method, equipment and bait;
• likely species, season, size, bag and possession limits; and
• any required catch form before cutting at the water.
NO / SAVED OLD RULE / UNKNOWN → DO NOT FISH
ALL CURRENT AND CONFIRMED → CONTINUE
YES — NEXT CHECK
3 CAN YOU DEAL WITH EVERY LIKELY CATCH?
For every fish you are reasonably likely to catch here:
• can you positively identify it—not merely guess?
• do you know the current required immediate action?
• can you measure, release or lawfully retain it as required?
Identity, legal action and food safety are separate checks.
NO / UNKNOWN FOR ANY LIKELY CATCH → DO NOT FISH
YES FOR EVERY LIKELY CATCH → CONTINUE
YES — FINAL CHECK
4 ARE THE PLACE, GEAR AND TIME SAFE?
• Firm, reachable bank; no wading, climbing, flooded bank,
surf-rock ledge or current exposure
• Lawful, suitable gear and a manufactured hook you can handle
• Enough light, stable weather, warmth, energy and attention
• You can keep an attended line in sight and stay within 50 m
• Rescue, first aid, shelter and water will not be neglected
NO / CONDITIONS MAY DETERIORATE / UNKNOWN → DO NOT FISH
YES TO EVERY ITEM → CONDITIONAL FISHING MAY BEGIN
Retrieve the line and stop as soon as any answer changes.
ALL YES
FISH — ONLY WHILE EVERY GATE STAYS YES
Use only the current lawful, attended method.
Stop if the attempt costs warmth, safety, rescue time or water.
A catch still needs identity, legal-action and food-safety checks.
METHODS NOT SUPPLIED OR AUTHORISED
No trap, unattended or set line, poison, electricity,
indiscriminate capture, improvised raft or destructive method.
UNKNOWN AT ANY POINT = STOP / DO NOT FISH.
Basis: S-459 and Chapter 12 • Recheck current VFA rules and signs
WORKING DRAFT — NOT FIELD-APPROVED
